#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert a DOCX file to PDF and email it as an attachment."""

import os
import sys
import smtplib
import subprocess
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DOCX_PATH = "docs/customer_report.docx"
PDF_DIR = "docs"

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", "you@example.com")
SMTP_PASS = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASS", "")

SENDER = SMTP_USER
RECIPIENT = "bob@example.com"
SUBJECT = "Customer Report (PDF)"
BODY = "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"


# ── 1. Convert DOCX → PDF ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, out_dir: str) -> str:
    """Convert a .docx file to .pdf using LibreOffice (headless)."""
    docx = Path(docx_path)
    if not docx.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: '{docx}' not found.")

    print(f"Converting '{docx}' to PDF …")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "libreoffice",
            "--headless",
            "--convert-to", "pdf",
            str(docx),
            "--outdir", out_dir,
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"LibreOffice conversion failed:\n{result.stderr}")

    pdf_path = Path(out_dir) / docx.with_suffix(".pdf").name
    if not pdf_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: expected output '{pdf_path}' was not created.")

    print(f"Created '{pdf_path}'")
    return str(pdf_path)


# ── 2. Email the PDF ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def send_email(pdf_path: str) -> None:
    """Send an email with the PDF attached via SMTP (TLS)."""
    pdf = Path(pdf_path)

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = RECIPIENT
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.set_content(BODY)

    with open(pdf, "rb") as f:
        msg.add_attachment(
            f.read(),
            maintype="application",
            subtype="pdf",
            filename=pdf.name,
        )

    print(f"Sending '{pdf.name}' to {RECIPIENT} via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT} …")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        smtp.send_message(msg)

    print("Email sent successfully.")


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if __name__ == "__main__":
    pdf = convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_DIR)
    send_email(pdf)
